items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: I remember seeing Jake Hanna at the bar

ctx.x: He says, “Wayne, what’s—” And I don’t know Al Porcino that well. He says “Wayne, what’s going on over there? What in the world is this going on?” And we talked and talked and talked and talked. I says “Al, I don’t know, but I remember last night I subbed on Toshiko’s band and I remember seeing Jake Hanna at the bar and I remember seeing Jake Hanna dumping martinis down, and I’m wondering what in the hell he’s thinking about this morning. I never have spoken to Jake to find out, with this hangover he must have had…
